name: Sample: CRM
description: CRM-style accounts, contacts and support tickets for the customers of the SAP sample - the customer numbers match SAP's KUNNR without the leading zeros.

dictionary.title: CRM field dictionary
dictionary.content:
-- accounts  One row per CRM account (customer or prospect): account_id CRM account key (ACC-00001); account_name the name as the sales team writes it; sap_no the customer's SAP customer number (KUNNR) without leading zeros, e.g. 100001 for SAP '0000100001', empty for prospects; country ISO country code; industry; segment Enterprise, Mid-market or Small business; account_owner the sales rep; created_on date the account was created.
-- contacts  People at an account: contact_id; account_id the account they belong to; full_name; job_title; email.
-- tickets  Customer support tickets: ticket_id; account_id the account that raised it; opened_on; category (Delivery delay, Invoice question, Product defect, Spare parts, Installation, Account change, Warranty claim); priority Low, Medium, High or Urgent; status Open, In progress, Waiting on customer or Closed; closed_on date closed (empty while open); satisfaction customer rating 1-5 given when a ticket is closed.

documentation.title: About this data
documentation.content: A sample CRM for Acme Industrial: accounts, their contacts and the support tickets they raise. Accounts that are customers carry their SAP customer number in sap_no (without SAP's leading zeros); prospects have none. Data runs from January 2025 and was extracted on 2026-11-15 - use DATE '2026-11-15' as today.

documentation.title: Open tickets
documentation.content: A ticket is open while its status is not 'Closed' - that includes 'Open', 'In progress' and 'Waiting on customer'.

documentation.title: Response targets by priority
documentation.content: Urgent tickets should close within 3 days, High within 8, Medium within 15 and Low within 25 days. Time to close = closed_on - opened_on, in days.

documentation.title: Customers and prospects
documentation.content: An account with a sap_no is a customer that exists in SAP; an account without one is a prospect. To link a CRM account to SAP, match sap_no to the SAP customer number with the leading zeros removed.

examples.question: How many open tickets do we have by priority?
examples.sql:
SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS open_tickets
FROM tickets
WHERE status <> 'Closed'
GROUP BY priority
ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'Urgent' THEN 1 WHEN 'High' THEN 2 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

examples.question: Which accounts have the most open tickets?
examples.sql:
SELECT a.account_name, a.segment, COUNT(*) AS open_tickets
FROM tickets t
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.status <> 'Closed'
GROUP BY a.account_name, a.segment
ORDER BY open_tickets DESC
LIMIT 10

examples.question: What is the average customer satisfaction by ticket category?
examples.sql:
SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(satisfaction), 2) AS avg_satisfaction, COUNT(*) AS closed_tickets
FROM tickets
WHERE status = 'Closed' AND satisfaction IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY avg_satisfaction

examples.question: How many tickets were opened per month?
examples.sql:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', opened_on) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS tickets
FROM tickets
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

examples.question: How long does it take to close a ticket, by priority?
examples.sql:
SELECT priority, ROUND(AVG(closed_on - opened_on), 1) AS avg_days_to_close, COUNT(*) AS closed_tickets
FROM tickets
WHERE status = 'Closed'
GROUP BY priority
ORDER BY avg_days_to_close

examples.question: Which accounts are prospects without an SAP customer number?
examples.sql:
SELECT account_name, country, industry, account_owner, created_on
FROM accounts
WHERE sap_no IS NULL
ORDER BY created_on DESC

examples.question: How many contacts does each account owner manage?
examples.sql:
SELECT a.account_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS accounts, COUNT(c.contact_id) AS contacts
FROM accounts a
LEFT JOIN contacts c ON c.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY a.account_owner
ORDER BY contacts DESC
